summary:
Astera is an offline-first spacecraft crew medical and behavioral health decision-support console designed for long-duration deep-space missions. On missions to the Moon, Mars, and beyond, communication delays of up to 20 minutes each way and signal blackouts prevent real-time consultations with Earth's flight surgeons and psychologists, while extreme isolation and high workloads elevate risks of burnout and clinical emergencies.

We developed a hybrid onboard platform that combines continuous vital-sign tracking, structured Symptom Check triage, an automated Daily Check-In behavioral assessment, and Astera AI—a telemetry-aware onboard health assistant. Using a multi-rule scoring engine, Astera compares daily physical and psychological metrics against each astronaut's personal 7-day baseline to detect early warning trends (Green to Red), trigger immediate safety overrides, and queue priority reports for ground synchronization. When communications drop, Astera switches seamlessly to deterministic onboard protocols, empowering crews to manage health autonomously and safeguard mission success.
details:
What Astera Does & How It Works

Astera is an autonomous, offline-first crew medical and behavioral health console built for long-duration spaceflight. It unifies physical telemetry, psychological self-monitoring, clinical triage, and AI-guided support into one streamlined interface:

- Overview Dashboard: Displays real-time crew vitals, mission day context, and a high-visibility Daily Check-In status summary that immediately highlights elevated risks (Orange or Red).

- Daily Check-In & Autonomous Scoring Engine: A structured daily assessment covering 7 core domains (Sleep, Mood, Anxiety & Stress, Cognition & Workload, Energy & Motivation, Social & Environment, and Physical Health) plus a critical safety check. An automated multi-rule engine evaluates scores against configurable thresholds, the astronaut's personal 7-day baseline, multi-day deterioration trends, and immediate safety overrides to assign a clear status (Green, Yellow, Orange, or Red).

- Astera AI (Onboard Crew Counselor): A telemetry-aware assistant grounded in the astronaut's live vitals, recent check-in domain scores, and mission context. When connectivity is available, it uses the Google Gemini API; when offline, it switches seamlessly to a deterministic onboard clinical and behavioral protocol engine.

- Symptom Check & Emergency Protocols: Guides crew members through acute physical symptom triage and provides instant access to emergency stabilization steps.

- Local Health Log & Ground Uplink Queue: Stores all logs locally in SQLite and automatically queues priority reports for Earth's flight surgeons and psychologists whenever the communication link is active.

Benefits & Intended Impact

On deep-space missions to the Moon or Mars, two-way communication delays of up to 40 minutes and periodic solar or orbital blackouts make real-time tele-counseling impossible. Astera bridges this gap by empowering astronauts to detect early signs of burnout, sleep deprivation, or acute illness before they escalate into mission-critical emergencies—protecting crew well-being, cognitive performance, and mission safety.

Tools, Languages & Technologies Used

- Programming Language & Framework: Python, Streamlit (responsive desktop and mobile web architecture)

- Data Visualization & Storage: Plotly (interactive health and trend charts), SQLite (local-first persistent database)

- Artificial Intelligence: Google Gemini API paired with a custom rule-based offline fallback engine

- Design & Deployment: Custom CSS/SVG iconography (macOS / Apple Health-inspired Light & Dark themes), GitHub, Streamlit Cloud, and Netlify

Creativity & Key Factors Considered

- Hybrid Online/Offline Resilience: Designed specifically around deep-space latency and blackout constraints, featuring an explicit Offline Mode toggle and asynchronous ground-sync queue so the system never crashes or stalls without internet.

- Zero-Clutter Cognitive Ergonomics: Inspired by native macOS and Apple Health interfaces, Astera minimizes cognitive load for fatigued crew members through calm typography, clear color-coded status alerts, and mobile-ready controls.

- Clinical Adaptability & Personalization: Rather than relying solely on static population averages, Astera establishes an individual 7-day baseline for each crew member while keeping all scoring thresholds configurable for mission flight surgeons.
